newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - March 28.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - March 28.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 140.11 points to close at 6,740.59 on fears that rising interest rates will spell the end for Wall Street's record bull run.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index shed 2.28 points to 1,223.31. The all-share EMAS index fell 1.28 to 358.27.
* Malaysia's central bank releases 1996 annual report at 0900 GMT.
* National car distributor Edaran Otomobil Nasional posted a 36.4 percent increase in 1996 net profit.
* YTL Corp reported an 11 percent increase in half-year net earnings to 162.77 million ringgit.
* Malaysia Mining posted a 58.3 percent rise in full-year net profit to 43.66 million ringgit.
* IOI Corp reported a half-year net profit of 80.78 million ringgit, down from 84.41 million previously.
* Cahya Mata posted a 47 percent increase in 1996 net profit to 106.03 million ringgit.
